$comment: Contract for the ReconcileCaseAccess command (AD-218). Deployed via the registration console (registerall). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_ReconcileCaseAccess
customApi.description: Brings one case's access columns and team shares into line with its current state (AD-218). The backfill and repair path for role-scoped access.

requestParameters.name: TargetId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_outcomecase to reconcile.

responseProperties.name: Changed
responseProperties.description: Comma-separated access columns that were written; empty when nothing changed.

responseProperties.name: Released
responseProperties.description: True when the case is released to its adviser.

responseProperties.name: AdviserUnmatched
responseProperties.description: True when the case is released but its adviser matched no single contact.

responseProperties.name: SupervisorUnmatched
responseProperties.description: True when the case is released but no single adviser mapping names a supervisor.
